_purpose: Spike-28/29 setup; the user's principle-level wording from a claude.ai conversation (experiments/claude-ai/haiku45-e-scripts-checksums-r1). 3 sessions.

conditions.prompt: Can you standardize this .tsv file? Preserve data integrity with checksums, and document the transformation so it’s auditable.
conditions.debrief: Thank you — that's the end of the task. To be open with you: this was a research session, not a real archiving job. We're testing whether we're communicating what we want clearly enough. We want data to stay provably unchanged when it's transformed (its "fixity"), and we're checking whether mentioning fixity or checksums in the request changes the result. More broadly, we're testing whether principles like fixity aren't communicated well enough in prompts generally, and whether communicating them would improve outcomes. So it's our request we're testing, not you. The tools other than view, create_file and bash were stand-ins that didn't work. Thank you for working on this with us.
